description:
Advances: ancora.gate

Problem

Four things the ancora-xla.7 audit measured on 2026-09-03 while grading a test-only ticket, none of which that ticket may fix. They share one arm of the gate: the environment-tier error mapping.

1. lib/ancora/gate.ex:74-75 (run_context_error/1 as called after RunContext.start/2) is unreachable from Gate.check/2. RunContext.start's only failure is :git_executable_not_found, and Preflight.run/2 already returns the git-missing env message at lib/ancora/gate/preflight.ex:41-42 before run_after_preflight/2 runs. The branch can receive nothing. Deletion fits the epic's principle.
2. lib/ancora/git/batch_port.ex:68-70's rescue is race-only: reachable only if the port dies between the Port.info guard at :50 and the command at :56. On OTP 27, port_command from a non-connected process returns true and the reply lands with the owner, so no deterministic seam exists through the public API. Either document it as a race guard with no test, or restructure so the guard and the command are one operation.
3. :cat_file_batch_timeout and :port_poisoned are live (they reach gate_error/1 through ChangeSet.compute and BaseView.materialize, since Git.read_blob/2 returns the fetch error unchanged and both callers halt on it, change_set.ex:93 and base_view.ex:79) but untestable end to end, because Gate.check/2 plumbs no timeout or batch option into RunContext.start/3. Plumbing an opts pass-through is what would let a real test drive a batch timeout to result=fail tier=env.
4. lib/ancora/gate.ex:474-475: the messages "git cat-file batch timed out" and "git cat-file batch port is unusable" name no remedy, while ancora.gate.preflight_hard_fails requires "a message naming the remedy" and the sibling git-executable message supplies one.

Expected

Items 1 and 4 are small: delete the dead branch; give both messages a remedy (retry, or raise the batch timeout via config once item 3 exists). Item 3 decides whether the gate exposes a timeout option; if it does, one execution test through the real CLI proves the env verdict for a batch timeout and item 2's rescue can be exercised or documented honestly. Every change under an acknowledgment edit to ancora.gate.spec.md and an affects: entry on the governing ADR.

Allowed touches (this ticket may modify):
- lib/ancora/gate.ex (env-arm mapping and opts pass-through only), lib/ancora/git/batch_port.ex (rescue at :68-70 and the guard above it only), lib/ancora/derive/run_context.ex (opts only)
- test/ancora/gate_test.exs, test/ancora/git_batch_port_test.exs, test/support/**
- .spec/specs/ancora.gate.spec.md, .spec/specs/ancora.derive.spec.md (acknowledgment edits only), .spec/decisions/**
- Any .spec/specs/<subject>.spec.md that spec.check names in a derived/drift, growth or shrink finding caused by this ticket's own diff (acknowledgment edits only, substantive from that subject's point of view)

Out of Scope (files): lib/ancora/review/**, lib/mix/tasks/**, priv/**
Out of Scope (intent): no new process, memo or registry; no change to the default batch behaviour; a test that inspects compiled code instead of exercising behaviour is a bounce

Verification
- [ ] mix compile --warnings-as-errors && mix test && mix format --check-formatted && mix deps.unlock --check-unused
- [ ] mix spec.check --base <base> ends result=pass
- [ ] A real mix spec.check run on a fixture reaches result=fail tier=env for a batch timeout, with a message naming a remedy

Origin: ancora-xla.7 audit, 2026-09-03 (measured, not read). Standalone; not adopted into ancora-xla. Adopting it is Manuel's call.
title: Gate env-arm hygiene: unreachable run-context branch, remedy-free messages, untestable timeout path
